# HiddenFeeAI — AI-Powered Hidden Fee Detector

> AI-powered forensic document audits. Upload any invoice, bill, receipt, or contract and uncover hidden fees, billing errors, and savings opportunities in seconds.

---

## About

HiddenFeeAI analyzes financial documents using AI to detect hidden charges, billing errors, junk fees, and overcharges across industries including auto loans, medical billing, utility bills, subscriptions, contracts, and insurance.
